role_sequence_contract.item_order_policy: Role progression is ordered by selected area route -> role choice -> reviewed role-task context -> that context's role items and tools. Within one role-task group, only exact reviewed sequence edges order item pairs; all other items are skippable choices in that ordered context. Zero item-pair edges is an explicit source-reviewed disposition, not a missing role route or a stale route-order flag.
role_sequence_contract.role_task_context_policy: A selected area work focus may explain a role task only through a reviewed family-to-role-task edge. Every visible role item must continue through the selected domain -> method/design -> area -> role -> reviewed role task/foundation path. Role-task context is not a qualification, job-readiness finding or universal employer task list.
role_sequence_contract.role_item_placement_policy: Embed a role item under its reviewed role task family. Use a role foundation only when evidence shows it applies across the relevant role tasks. If neither route is supported, keep the item out of student selection; do not create a general standalone role-item lane.
role_sequence_contract.role_prerequisite_note_policy: Preparation notes are preserved under the exact role item as context, not turned into a universal order or blocker. Add a typed prerequisite/workflow edge only with an exact target, route condition and source that supports the relationship.
